entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2 23-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

This application has been filed for quashing of order dated 12.06.2008 passed by Learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Bagha at West Champaran in Complaint Case No. 278 of 2008/Tr. No. 2334 of 2015 by which cognizance has been taken against the petitioners for the offences under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Bagha at West Champaran
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The impugned order has been passed on 12.06.2008 and the quashing application has been filed in 2015 after Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.58221 of 2015(2) dt.23-03-2023 inordinate delay that too without satisfactory explanation of the delay.
Accordingly, this application is dismissed on the ground of delay and latches.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Harsh/ U Raj Deyee Devi And Anr vs State Of Bihar And Anr on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123691617/
